name: TextBox 8
text:
The StreakLabs solution


Start with any topic or upload class notes to begin a guided lesson.
 Ask follow-up questions with an AI tutor using the lesson or your notes.
Create roadmaps, mind maps, cheat sheets and practice; plan study and track active time.

name: TextBox 8
text:
Frontend: React, JavaScript and Vite; backend: Node.js and Express REST API
Data and sign-in: Supabase Auth and Postgres with Row Level Security. Flow: topic or notes → AI lesson → tutor questions; study sessions update the streak matrix.

name: TextBox 8
text:
Target users: students learning school, college or personal-interest topics.
Potential benefits: organized study materials, lessons based on personal notes, useful revision aids, a weekly plan and visible study consistency.
